topic: Filing a Change-of-Address Form at the Post Office

script.title: CHANGING MY ADDRESS
script.story_hook: A quick post office trip to fix the mail.
script.intro_zh: 一趟短暫的郵局之行，把郵件轉寄全部安排好。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the post office counter. Listen for change-of-address phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到郵局櫃台。留意搬家改地址的說法。
script.outro: And the mail now follows you home. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 郵件就這樣跟著你搬到新家。再聽一次，跟著一起複習。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early thirties with curly dark brown hair under a knit beanie, a light beard, round glasses, a grey hoodie under a denim jacket, and a tall lean build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman in her forties with straight shoulder-length auburn hair, rectangular glasses, a navy postal uniform vest over a white shirt, a name tag, and a medium build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to change my mailing address.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə tʃeɪndʒ maɪ ˈmeɪlɪŋ əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要更改我的郵寄地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing, moving somewhere new, congrats!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ θɪŋ ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈsʌmwɛɹ nju kənˈɡɹæts/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，要搬到新地方囉，恭喜你！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, it's a small place across town.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ɪts ə smɔːl pleɪs əˈkɹɑs taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，是城裡另一頭的一間小公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we can do that right here today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wi kən du ðæt raɪt hɪɹ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今天在這裡就能幫你辦好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Should I fill out the paper form?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ʃʊd aɪ fɪl aʊt ðə ˈpeɪpɚ fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我該自己填寫這張紙本表格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, or I type it, whichever's faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kən ɔɹ aɪ taɪp ɪt wɪtʃˈɛvɚz ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，或我幫你打字，怎麼快怎麼來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You type, please, my handwriting's a crime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju taɪp pliz maɪ ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋz ə kraɪm/
dialogue.zh: 拜託你打，我字寫得真亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll take that as a joke, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl teɪk ðæt æz ə dʒoʊk ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我就當它是玩笑話啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what do you need from me first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt du ju nid fɹəm mi fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 那，你需要我先給你什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your old address, and then the new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ oʊld əˈdrɛs ænd ðɛn ðə nju wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你的舊地址，然後是新地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old is 22 Grove, apartment four, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ɪz ˈtwɛnti tu ɡɹoʊv əˈpɑɹtmənt fɔɹ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 舊的是 Grove 二十二號，四號公寓，很好唸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, and the new place is where?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ænd ðə nju pleɪs ɪz wɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，那新的地方在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: 18 Elm Court, unit two, near the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin ɛlm ˈkɔɹt ˈjunɪt tu nɪɹ ðə pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: Elm Court 十八號，二單元，靠近公園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Elm Court, got it, that's the east side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛlm kɔɹt ɡɑt ɪt ðæts ði ist saɪd/
dialogue.zh: Elm Court，記下了，那是東邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yep, closer to work, plus a bigger kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈkloʊsɚ tə wɝɹk plʌz ə ˈbɪɡɚ ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，離工作近一點，廚房還比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice upgrade. When should mail start moving?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈʌpˌɡɹeɪd wɛn ʃʊd meɪl stɑɹt ˈmuːvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不錯耶。郵件要從哪天開始轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, the first of next month, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə fɝst ʌv nɛkst mʌnθ ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，下個月一號開始，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine, we start forwarding that morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn wi stɑɹt ˈfɔɹwɛɹdɪŋ ðæt ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，那天早上就開始轉寄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forwarding? So you send it on for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹwɛɹdɪŋ soʊ ju sɛnd ɪt ɑn fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 轉寄？就是你們幫我把信寄過去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, we redirect everything to the new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wi ˌɹiːdɪˈɹɛkt ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ tə ðə nju pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我們把所有郵件改送到新地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For how long, though? A month or more?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ haʊ lɔŋ ðoʊ ə mʌnθ ɔɹ mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那要轉多久？一個月還是更久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standard is a full year, that's plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɚd ɪz ə fʊl jɪɹ ðæts ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 標準是一年，絕對夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A year is great, I was worried actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə jɪɹ ɪz ɡɹeɪt aɪ wəz ˈwɝid ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 一年太棒了，我原本還在擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people are, it's the first time, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl ɑɹ ðɪts ðə fɝst taɪm ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 多數人都會，這是第一次嘛，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First time for me, yeah, exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst taɪm fɔɹ mi jeɪ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 對我來說是第一次，一點沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stress, it's the same form every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stɹɛs ɪts ðə seɪm fɔɹm ˈɛvɹi taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 別緊張，每次都填一樣的表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to show any kind of proof?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə ʃoʊ ˈɛni kaɪnd əv pɹuːf/
dialogue.zh: 我需要出示什麼證明文件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just an ID, that's all we check.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst eɪn aɪˈdi ðæts ɔːl wi tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 只要一張身分證，我們就核對這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my license, name's Danny, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns neɪmz ˈdæni baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的駕照，對了，我叫 Danny。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks Danny, how do you spell your last name?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈdæni haʊ du ju spɛl jɔɹ læst neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝 Danny，問一下，姓氏怎麼拼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's V-O-S-S, all caps, easy enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts viː oʊ ˌɛs ˈɛs ɔːl kæps ˈizi ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 是 V-O-S-S，全部大寫，很好拼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, Voss, that one's down for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt vɑs ðæt wʌnz daʊn fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，Voss，這個幫你打好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Can my family share one form?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul kən maɪ ˈfæməli ʃɛɹ wʌn fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 好。家人可以用同一張表格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you share the old address with them.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf ju ʃɛɹ ði oʊld əˈdrɛs wɪð ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要你和他們同住舊地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My roommate's staying, so it's just me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɹumˌmeɪts ˈsteɪɪŋ soʊ ɪts dʒʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 我的室友會留下來，所以只有我搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple then, one line, just you moving out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl ðɛn wʌn laɪn dʒʌst ju ˈmuːvɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那就單純，一欄，只有你搬走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's also my little sister, um, moving too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ˈɔːlsoʊ maɪ ˈlɪɾəɹ ˈsɪstɚ ʌm ˈmuːvɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 還有我妹妹，嗯，她也要搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can add her, does she live there too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən æd hɜɹ dʌz ʃi lɪv ðɛɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以加上她，她也住那邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not really, she's just staying a few weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɹiːli ʃi dʒʌst ˈsteɪɪŋ ə fju wikz/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，她只是暫住幾個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a temporary change fits her better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə ˈtɛmpəɹɛɹi tʃeɪndʒ fɪts hɜɹ ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那選暫時改地址更適合她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, what does temporary mean, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wʌt dʌz ˈtɛmpəɹɛɹi min ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 噢，暫時是什麼意思，具體來說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ends by itself after a set date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf ˈæftɚ ə sɛt deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 到了設定的日期，它會自己停止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's perfect, she leaves before winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈpɝfɪkt ʃi livz bɪˈfɔɹ ˈwɪnɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，她冬天之前就會走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll set hers to end in November then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt hɜɹz tə ɛnd ɪn noʊˈvɛmbɚ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那我就把她的設成十一月結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, thank you for sorting that out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt θæŋk ju fɔɹ ˈsɔɹtɪŋ ðæt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你幫我把這件事理清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, there's a small one dollar fee to verify.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðɛɹz ə smɔːl wʌn ˈdɑːlɚ fi tə ˈvɛɹəˌfaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有，要收一美元來做驗證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dollar? Um, is that actually legit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdɑːlɚ ʌm ɪz ðæt ˈæktʃuəli lɪˈdʒɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一美元？嗯，這不會是詐騙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's real, they mail a tiny postcard.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪts ɹiːəl ðeɪ meɪl ə ˈtaɪni ˈpoʊstˌkɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 不會，是真的，他們會寄一張小明信片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A postcard? To prove the address is live.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpoʊstˌkɑɹd tə pɹuːv ði əˈdrɛs ɪz laɪv/
dialogue.zh: 明信片？用來證明地址是真實的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we take card, not cash, here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd wi teɪk kɑɹd nɑt kæʃ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，這裡只收刷卡，不收現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, card is fine, let me just...
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kɑɹd ɪz faɪn lɛt mi dʒʌst/
dialogue.zh: 好，刷卡沒問題，我只要……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, the reader's right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm ðə ˈɹidɚz raɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，感應機就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, it didn't beep, did it go through?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪt ˈdɪdənt bip dɪd ɪt ɡoʊ θɹu/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它沒嗶，這樣有成功嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try once more, hold it flat and steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹaɪ wʌns mɔɹ hoʊld ɪt flæt ænd ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，平平拿穩就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, it says approved, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wi ɡoʊ ɪt sɛz əˈpɹuːvd hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，它顯示通過了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, you'll get the postcard soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːl dʌn jʊl ɡɛt ðə ˈpoʊstˌkɑɹd sun/
dialogue.zh: 全部搞定，你很快就會收到那張明信片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get an email copy of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ ɡɛt æn ˈiːmeɪl ˈkɑpi ʌv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 會給我這單的電子郵件存檔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will, plus a confirmation number too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl plʌz ə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən ˈnʌmbɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 會的，還會附一個確認編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's everything, I really appreciate the help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ aɪ ˈɹiːli əˈpɹiʃieɪt ðə hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 這樣就齊全了，真的很感謝你的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to, enjoy the new place, Danny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə nju pleɪs ˈdæni/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，好好享受新居喔，Danny。

script.youtube_title: 【剛搬新家📦】「我字寫得真亂」教你在郵局改地址📮🏠｜聽完就能自己辦轉寄｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Change of Address
script.youtube_title_en: "My Handwriting's a Crime" — Filing a Change of Address at the Post Office
script.youtube_description:
「我字寫得真亂」——剛搬進新家，郵件怎麼跟著搬？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在郵局的服務櫃台。

你會聽到：開場說明要改地址、報舊址與新址的完整句；轉寄是什麼、要轉一年、暫時改址怎麼選；家人與室友能不能同一張表格；還有一美元驗證、刷卡、感應沒通過的真實處理方式。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人真實語感：um、so、ha、yeah。聽完你就會用：I need to change...、For how long、Card is fine、That's everything。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My handwriting's a crime" — you just moved, so how does the mail follow you? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at the post office counter.

You will hear: asking to change an address, giving the old and new one; what forwarding means, the full-year rule, and choosing a temporary change; adding family or not; and the one dollar verify fee, card payment, and a reader that doesn't beep.

Everything stays in A2 words with real filler words Americans use: um, so, ha, yeah. By the end you'll own I need to change..., For how long..., Card is fine, and That's everything.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧郵局改地址英文｜舊址與新址・轉寄一年・一美元驗證｜搬家必辦清單｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛搬進新家，信件要怎麼跟著搬？舊地址、新地址怎麼報？為什麼郵局要收一塊錢？這些問題你真的問得出口嗎？

這一集帶大家走進郵局櫃台，從說明改地址、報舊址與新址，一路聽到轉寄一年、暫時改址、家人同表與一美元驗證，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏠 開場句：Hi, I need to change my mailing address.
📮 問轉寄：For how long, though? A month or more?
👪 家人同表：Can my family share one form?
💳 驗證費：A dollar? Um, is that actually legit?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟郵局之行走一遍，下次自己搬家，改地址的話就自己冒出來。

祝你搬家順利，信一封都不遺失。
script.thumbnail_action: handing a messy paper form across the counter
